segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "database" when I talk about my computer project. I say "table" when I talk about my computer project. I say "row" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use database, table, and row. At the end, I say: I can use database clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“数据库、表与查询”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。database：数据库，按照结构长期保存和查询数据的系统。示例：I learned how to use "database" in a computer task.table：数据表，以行和列组织数据的结构。示例：I learned how to use "table" in a computer task.row：行，表中一条完整的数据记录。示例：I learned how to use "row" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.en: Today I practise daily English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "What are you working on?" in a daily conversation. I say "I'm working on ..." in a daily conversation. I say "I've finished ..." in a daily conversation. I tell my teammate: Today I use What are you working on?, I'm working on ..., and I've finished .... At the end, I say: I can use What are you working on? clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“日常交流英语”，场景是“工作进度沟通”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。What are you working on?：你正在做什么？。示例：What are you working on?I'm working on ...：我正在处理……。示例：I'm working onI've finished ...：我已经完成……。示例：I've finished最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

I say "My next step is ..." in a daily conversation. I say "I need more time." in a daily conversation. I tell my teammate: Today I use I'm blocked by ..., My next step is ..., and I need more time.. At the end, I say: I can use I'm blocked by ... clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“日常交流英语”，场景是“工作进度沟通”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。I'm blocked by ...：我被……阻碍了。。示例：I'm blocked byMy next step is ...：我的下一步是……。示例：My next step isI need more time.：我需要更多时间。。示例：I need more time.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“持续集成”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。continuous integration：持续集成，频繁合并并自动验证代码的做法。示例：Our team uses "continuous integration" to keep the project clear.GitHub Actions：GitHub 自动化服务，可运行测试和部署任务。示例：Our team uses "Git Hub Actions" to keep the project clear.workflow file：工作流文件，用 YAML 定义自动化步骤。示例：Our team uses "workflow file" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
